name: BTG anti-proliferation factor 1

function.text: BTG1 encodes protein BTG1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and kinase binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and cell migration.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: BTG1 has been involved in chromosomal rearrangements reported in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
